queries.name: AssessmentResults
queries.lastLoadedAsTableFormulaText:
{"IncludesReferencedQueries":false,"RootFormulaText":"let
  Bs=Table.ToRecords(Builds),
  Rows=List.Combine(List.Transform(Bs,(b)=>
    let
      Sarif=fxArtifactSarif(b[id]),
      Runs=Record.FieldOrDefault(Sarif,"runs",{}),
      Found=List.Combine(List.Transform(Runs,(run)=>List.Transform(Record.FieldOrDefault(run,"results",{}),(r)=>
        let
          Msg=Record.FieldOrDefault(r,"message",[]),
          Locs=Record.FieldOrDefault(r,"locations",{}),
          Loc=if List.Count(Locs)>0 then Locs{0} else [],
          Ph=Record.FieldOrDefault(Loc,"physicalLocation",[]),
          Ar=Record.FieldOrDefault(Ph,"artifactLocation",[])
        in [BuildId=b[id],BuildNumber=b[buildNumber],RuleId=Record.FieldOrDefault(r,"ruleId",null),Level=Record.FieldOrDefault(r,"level",null),Kind=Record.FieldOrDefault(r,"kind",null),Message=Record.FieldOrDefault(Msg,"text",null),TargetUri=Record.FieldOrDefault(Ar,"uri",null)]
      )))
    in Found
  )),
  Output=if List.Count(Rows)=0 then #table({"BuildId","BuildNumber","RuleId","Level","Kind","Message","TargetUri"},{}) else Table.FromRecords(Rows)
in Output","ReferencedQueriesFormulaText":{}}

queries.name: fxArtifactSarif
text: Check=if Type<>"container" then error "Expected a Build Artifact file container" else true,

Raw=if Check then Web.Contents("https://dev.azure.com",[RelativePath=C[Organization]&"/_apis/resources/Containers/"&ContainerId,Query=[itemPath=C[ArtifactName]&"/"&C[SarifFileName],#"api-version"="7.1"],Headers=[Accept="application/octet-stream"]]) else error "Invalid artifact",
